title: Episode 79 — The Guru Tests the Congregation

blocks.text: Guru Gobind Singh stages a dramatic test to reveal the difference between true Sikhs and the merely curious. When he asks for a willing head, panic spreads and many ran away from the congregation rather than remain under the Guru's terrible command.

The page sharply contrasts that fear with the steadiness of the Majhail Singhs, whose loyalty remains firm even when the demand seems fatal. Their refusal to flee begins to define martyrdom as disciplined trust rather than impulsive bravery.
In this way the scene is not random severity but deliberate revelation. The congregation is forced to show, in public, what each person's attachment to the Guru can actually bear.
